$schema_note: Facts about the relate CLI for the docs pipeline (DOCS-PLAN.md §8 check 3, the <ExitCodes>/<Flags>/<EnvVars> components). Summaries are paraphrases; strings in `messages` and in backticks are quoted from the sources character for character. `disputed: true` marks a fact the sources disagree on; both readings are recorded and the release binary decides (DOCS-PLAN.md §9).

commands.summary: Run a statement session: one statement or a `;`-separated list (positional or `-c`), a script on piped stdin, or the interactive shell on a terminal. Takes every query-run flag.

commands.synopsis: relate clone [--wal-dir DIR] [--to-snapshot-format F] SOURCE DEST
commands.summary: Copy a store into a new store and exit. Each side is a directory, or a `.rl` bundle when its path ends in `.rl`. The source opens read-only; the destination must not exist; `:memory:` is refused on both sides.

flags.summary: Source WAL of a directory source; fails with a bundle source.
Destination snapshot codec; transcodes the published checkpoint.

readings.text: json or parquet, when compiled in

commands.summary: Print store metadata from a cold read (no open, no lock, no WAL replay) and exit: layout, codec and format version, checkpoint LSN, size on disk, checkpoint-time counts, the index and constraint catalog. `:memory:` is rejected.

flags.summary: Store to inspect: a directory or a `.rl` bundle.
One JSON object instead of the key/value table.

commands.summary: Install, remove, list or drift-check the agent skill bundle in each detected agent's skills folder. `check` exits 1 on drift.

flags.summary: Scope the action to one agent (case-insensitive).
Clobber `<skills dir>/relate` even when the command would refuse it; a usage error on `list` and `check`.

messages: Error: skill: refusing to touch <dest>: no .relate-installed marker present (directory was not created by relate); pass --force to override

commands.summary: Self-update to the latest release listed in https://relatedb.ai/releases.json; `--check` is a read-only current-versus-latest report; `--yes` installs the skill bundle after the upgrade when none is installed.

flags.summary: Install the skill bundle after the upgrade when none is installed yet, without a prompt.
Read-only report of the current and latest versions.

commands.summary: Manage anonymous usage metrics. `status` prints `<enabled|disabled> (<layer>)`; `off` persists the opt-out in `<config>/relate/config.json`.

commands.synopsis: relate pull [--from FILE] --query Q [--param N=V] [--allow-plaintext] --database PATH
commands.summary: Pull a Neo4j or Aura subgraph over HTTP Query API v2 into `--database` (union and upsert on the source `elementId`). `Q` is a statement, a `;`-separated list, a file path, or `-` for stdin. Always writes the `neo4j` namespace.
messages: Error: --namespace is not valid with pull (pull always writes the neo4j namespace)

commands.synopsis: relate push --to CREDS --database PATH [--query Q | --labels L1,L2 | --types T1,T2] [--batch-size N] [--nodes-update POLICY] [--rels-update POLICY] [--updated-at NAME[,NAME]] [--rel-mode MODE] [--merge-key LABEL:PROP[,PROP]] [--rel-key TYPE:PROP[,PROP]] [--unkeyed-labels ACTION] [--dry-run] [--json] [--allow-plaintext]
commands.summary: Push a scoped subgraph of `--database` into a Neo4j or Aura remote over HTTP Query API v2. `--dry-run` prints the plan without touching the remote.

commands.synopsis: relate serve --database PATH [--load SOURCE] [--host HOST] [--http PORT] [--mcp PORT|stdio] [--bolt PORT [--bolt-identity STRING]] [--read-only[=FRESHNESS]] [--auth USER:PASSWORD] [--concurrent-logical-workspace-limit SIZE] [--max-traversal-depth N] [--expression-memory-limit SIZE] [--safe | --no-safe] [--logical-graph-size-limit SIZE] [--durability-mode MODE]
commands.summary: Host the network surfaces (HTTP Query API v2, MCP over stdio or streamable HTTP, Bolt) on one open store until SIGINT or SIGTERM. At least one surface flag is required. Binds `127.0.0.1` by default; ports have no defaults.

flags.summary: Bind host for every served surface; a non-loopback value exposes the plaintext surfaces and prints a startup WARNING.
HTTP Query API v2 on HOST:PORT.
MCP: `stdio` runs the stdio transport in the foreground (no auth); `PORT` serves streamable HTTP.
Bolt and Bolt-over-WebSocket on HOST:PORT.
HELLO SUCCESS `server` agent string for the Bolt surface.
Open the existing store read-only: no writer lease, never creates it, every write fails; `live` tails the WAL (directories only). The MCP surface does not list `write_cypher`.
Load a store from a source (a local `.rl`, a directory, or an http(s) URL to a `.rl`) into `--database`.
One basic-auth credential shared by every served listener; `none` disables authentication. HTTP transport only for MCP.
Allow a browser Origin on the HTTP surface (repeatable; an explicit list replaces the default).
Seconds an HTTP managed transaction may sit idle before it expires (404/`42N90`); `0` disables.
Cap on open HTTP managed transactions; a begin over the cap answers 429/`42N91`; `0` is unlimited.
Process-wide session cap shared by every listener; `0` is unlimited.
Cap on concurrent Bolt-over-WebSocket sessions.

flags.default: loopback plus https://browser.neo4j.io and https://console.neo4j.io with auth on; loopback only with --auth none
flags.summary: Allow this Origin on Bolt-over-WebSocket upgrades (repeatable).
Absolute deadline for a complete HTTP or MCP request header block; `0` disables.
Absolute deadline for a complete HTTP or MCP request body; `0` disables.
The query session's flags of the same name, applied to the serve open with the same resolution.

commands.summary: Dispatch an installed extension package: the host parses the action's flags from its manifest, drives the child over MCP into a host-owned store, and prints the child's summary. First-party packages: `fs-to-graph`, `git-to-graph`.

Author and manage extension packages: `init <name> [--lang sh|py|ts|rust]` scaffolds one, `install <name>` installs from the signed first-party channel, a commit-pinned GitHub release (`--github`), a URL (`--url`) or a directory (`--from`), `list` prints the installed set, `remove` uninstalls, `check <dir>` runs the six mount stages without installing.

Print the compact agent briefing: the binary version, one line per compiled-in command, the query-run flag names and the exit-code table; with a command word, that command's synopsis, flags and examples. Always exits 0 once its arguments parse.

readings.text: shipped (in the full and agent bundles)

global_flags_note: The query-run flags: accepted on the path-first form and on `relate query`. Lifecycle-command flags are listed under each command.

global_flags.summary: The store target: a directory, a `.rl` bundle (legacy `.cl` bundles still open), or `:memory:`. Never a URL; a remote store is a `--load` source.
One statement or a `;`-separated list; the same as the positional QUERY, and the two cannot be combined.

Load a store's content from a source (a local `.rl` bundle, a directory, or an http(s) URL to a `.rl` bundle) into the target: into `:memory:` it is an ephemeral read-only open; into a new `-d PATH` it creates the store.
global_flags.note: Documented in the query section, not in the Query-engine flags table.
sources: docs/api/cli/spec.md § Loading a store from a source

global_flags.default: table on a terminal; jsonl when stdout is piped or redirected; toon when agent mode is in effect and stdout is piped
global_flags.summary: Output mode: `table`, `csv`, `json`, `jsonl`, `envelope`, `markdown`, `cypher`, `toon`, `speedscope`. An explicit mode always overrides the default.

global_flags.summary: Shortcut for `--mode json`: indented on a terminal, one compact line when piped.
Shortcut for `--mode csv`.
Shortcut for `--mode jsonl`.
Shortcut for `--mode markdown`.
Shortcut for `--mode toon`.
Force indented `json` output when stdout is not a terminal; ignored by the other modes.
Suppress column headers.
Bind a Cypher parameter (repeatable); V is a JSON scalar, array or map, or a bare word string.
Fetch an http(s) URL or read a file, parse it as JSON, and bind it as parameter N (repeatable; 64 MiB cap, 60 s timeout). A CLI-process fetch with no URL allowlist.

global_flags.default: parquet (json in builds without the parquet feature)
global_flags.summary: Snapshot codec for an empty directory; existing stores keep their recorded codec.
Local WAL directory for a directory store; rejected for `.rl` bundles.
Timed checkpoint period; `0` disables the timer. Persistent stores only.
Commit durability policy. `everysecond` can lose about the last second of acknowledged writes in a crash; `snapshot` can lose every write since the last completed checkpoint.
Live graph and index cap in logical bytes; `0` or unset is unlimited.
Per-allocation expression cap; `none` or `0` disables it.
Shared logical-workspace pool; a positive value turns query admission on; `0` is rejected.
Largest explicit traversal hop bound (1 through 2000); a larger bound fails at admission with `TraversalDepthExceeded`.
Opt-in safe mode: refuses a new named node without a label, and a `MATCH` read whose final `RETURN`/`WITH` has no `LIMIT` and no reducing aggregate, as `SafeModeViolation` (exit 6).
Per-statement wall-clock bound: a bare number is seconds, `ms`/`s`/`m` suffixes, fractions allowed; `0` disables. A timed-out statement exits 7 with `code: "timeout"`.

Open an existing store without writing, checkpointing or migrating. `snapshot` (default) freezes the state at open; `live` tails a directory store's WAL (refused for `.rl` and `:memory:`). Attached form only; once only. A write fails with exit 6.
Allow local `LOAD CSV` only for regular files under this directory; per-file limit 8 MiB.

global_flags.default: detected (stdout not a terminal and an agent harness variable set)
global_flags.summary: Turn agent ergonomics (the row-cap default and the piped `toon` default) on or off unconditionally; overrides `RELATE_AGENT_MODE` and detection.

global_flags.summary: Print usage to stdout and exit 0; after a command word, that command's help.
Print `Relate v<version>` and `License: Apache 2.0 (binary)`; with `--json`, one JSON object with `arch`, `license`, `name`, `os`, `version`.
Treat all following arguments as positional.

environment_variables.name: DO_NOT_TRACK
environment_variables.summary: `1`/`true` disables anonymous usage metrics; beats every other layer.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_TELEMETRY
environment_variables.summary: `0`/`false`/`off` disables, `1`/`true`/`on` enables anonymous usage metrics.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_AGENT_MODE
environment_variables.summary: `1` turns agent ergonomics on, `0` off; any other value exits 2.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MAX_ROWS
environment_variables.summary: Default row cap per statement; `0` is unlimited; a bad value exits 2.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_SAFE_MODE
environment_variables.summary: `1` turns safe mode on, `0` off; any other value exits 2.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_PREVIEW
environment_variables.summary: Comma-separated preview Cypher features to enable (for example `ontology`, `hybrid-search`); an unknown name fails the open with exit 1.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_SNAPSHOT_FORMAT
environment_variables.summary: Default snapshot codec for an empty directory.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_SECS
environment_variables.summary: Default timed checkpoint period.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_DURABILITY_MODE
environment_variables.summary: Default commit durability policy: `full`, `everysecond` or `snapshot`; any other value exits 2.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_LOGICAL_GRAPH_SIZE_LIMIT
environment_variables.summary: Default live graph and index cap; `0` or unset is unlimited.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_EXPRESSION_MEMORY_LIMIT
environment_variables.summary: Default per-allocation expression cap; `none`/`0` disables it.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_CONCURRENT_LOGICAL_WORKSPACE_LIMIT
environment_variables.summary: Default concurrent logical-workspace pool; a positive size turns admission on; `0` exits 2.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MAX_TRAVERSAL_DEPTH
environment_variables.summary: Default traversal-depth admission limit, 1 through 2000.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_LOAD_CSV_DIR
environment_variables.summary: Fallback CSV directory when the flag is absent; neither set means local files are denied.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_HELP_EXAMPLES
environment_variables.summary: `0`, `false`, `off` or `no` drops the Examples section from every help page.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_AUTH
environment_variables.summary: Basic-auth credential (`user:password` or `none`) for every served network surface; `--auth` overrides it.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_PATTERN_ENGINE
environment_variables.summary: Diagnostic pattern-engine switch: `auto`, `nfa` or `walk`. Not a supported tuning knob.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_BULK_BATCH_THRESHOLD
environment_variables.summary: Estimated touched-entity count at which an eligible global bulk write switches to batched commits.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_BULK_BATCH_BUDGET
environment_variables.summary: Estimated touched-entity budget per batch commit of an eligible global bulk write.

environment_variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environment_variables.summary: Optional bearer token for release-asset downloads; required while the repository is internal.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_RELEASES_JSON_URL
environment_variables.summary: Override the release-metadata URL (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: RELATE_EXTENSIONS_JSON_URL
environment_variables.summary: Override the extension channel-index URL (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: RELATE_RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_URL
environment_variables.summary: Override the base of the direct release-download route (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: RELATE_GITHUB_API_URL
environment_variables.summary: Override the base of the GitHub API asset route (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: NEO4J_URI
environment_variables.summary: Source Query API URI when `--from` is omitted.

environment_variables.name: NEO4J_USERNAME
environment_variables.summary: Source username when `--from` is omitted (`NEO4J_USER` also accepted).

environment_variables.name: NEO4J_PASSWORD
environment_variables.summary: Source password when `--from` is omitted.

environment_variables.name: NEO4J_DATABASE
environment_variables.summary: Source database name when `--from` is omitted.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MIXPANEL_ENDPOINT
environment_variables.summary: Override the Mixpanel /track URL (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MIXPANEL_TOKEN
environment_variables.summary: Override the compiled-in Mixpanel project token (dev and test).

environment_variables.name: RELATE_TELEMETRY_FLUSH_MS
environment_variables.summary: The exit flush's wait budget in milliseconds; `0` is fire-and-forget.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_TX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS
environment_variables.summary: Default HTTP managed-transaction idle timeout.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MAX_OPEN_TRANSACTIONS
environment_variables.summary: Default cap on open HTTP managed transactions.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_MAX_CONNECTIONS
environment_variables.summary: Default process-wide session cap.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS
environment_variables.summary: Default cap on Bolt-over-WebSocket sessions.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_HEADER_DEADLINE_SECS
environment_variables.summary: Default HTTP/MCP header deadline.

environment_variables.name: RELATE_BODY_DEADLINE_SECS
environment_variables.summary: Default HTTP/MCP body deadline.

RFC 4180 CSV with control escaping and a spreadsheet-formula guard (a leading `=`, `+`, `-`, `@` gets a `'` prefix, so `-5` prints as `'-5`).
One JSON array; indented on a terminal, compact when piped (`--pretty` forces indentation).
One JSON object per row; the default when stdout is piped and agent mode is off.
One compact JSON object per result set: `columns`, `columnTypes`, `rows` (keys sorted), `truncated`, `rowCap` when cut, `notifications`, `plan` on EXPLAIN/PROFILE.

fields.name: code
fields.meaning: The stable class name from the exit-code table; branch on this.

fields.name: kind
fields.meaning: The engine error variant: syntax, semantic, argument, type, execution, conflict, capacity, storage, locked, io, internal.

fields.name: message
fields.meaning: The sanitized text also printed on stderr.

fields.name: retryable
fields.meaning: true only for a write-write conflict; a locked store is not retryable until its other opener exits.

fields.name: statement
fields.meaning: Multi-statement runs only: the 1-based index of the failed statement.

fields.name: statements
fields.meaning: With statement: how many statements the input held.

fields.name: committed
fields.meaning: With statement: how many earlier statements are durable (0 inside an open .begin transaction).

fields.name: column
fields.meaning: Syntax errors only, when known: the 1-based character column within source.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Syntax errors only, when known: the statement line the parser echoed.

fields.name: line
fields.meaning: Syntax errors only, when the parser reported a position but no source line.

error_object.scope: Query runs only (one-shot and piped stdin). Lifecycle commands and the interactive shell print no error object.

exit_codes.meaning: Success, including an empty result. `--help` and `--version` also exit 0.
Runtime failure: store open or I/O error, capacity limit, query execution failure, internal error, failed final checkpoint.
Unknown flag, bad or missing value, extra positional.
Write-write conflict, or the store is locked by another opener.
The statement is rejected: syntax, semantic, argument or type error, including a write on a `--read-only` database.

agent_mode.summary: Agent ergonomics (the 100-row cap default and the piped toon default) resolve through one ladder: the `--agent-mode`/`--no-agent-mode` flag, then `RELATE_AGENT_MODE=1/0`, then detection gated on stdout not being a terminal. Writes are not gated by harness detection.
